name: Shops at Breakwater
summary: Shops at Breakwater is a neighborhood shopping center located in the growing Lake Houston area of northeast Houston, managed by Hunington Properties, Inc. The center serves local residents with convenient retail and service options, maintaining a strong 4.5-star rating.
demographics: Shops at Breakwater serves the growing Lake Houston area in northeast Houston, attracting middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $125,000. The primary trade area consists of young professionals and families with children, typically aged 30-55, who value convenience and accessibility in their shopping destinations. The center draws from the rapidly developing residential communities along West Lake Houston Parkway, where residents seek everyday retail services and dining options close to home.
description: Shops at Breakwater is a neighborhood shopping center strategically located at 16430 West Lake Houston Parkway in the thriving Lake Houston area of northeast Houston, Texas. Managed by Hunington Properties, Inc., a full-service commercial real estate company with nearly four decades of experience in the Houston market, this center serves the growing residential communities in the area with convenient retail and service options. The property benefits from Hunington Properties' extensive expertise in property management, leasing, and tenant advisory services, ensuring optimal tenant mix and customer experience. With a strong 4.5-star rating from 50 reviews, Shops at Breakwater has established itself as a reliable shopping destination for local residents. The center's location along West Lake Houston Parkway provides excellent visibility and accessibility, making it an ideal stop for everyday shopping needs in this rapidly developing corridor of Houston.
